On Fri, Jan 13, 2023 at 5:35 PM Meral Karan <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Croshelle,
Was great chatting earlier with you both - happy to do it regularly. I'm also copying colleagues on my team who are
focusing on MDM -Susan Abbott (who authored the Disinfo Primer) and Kris Svingen (recently joined USAID from
Treasury). These guys are leading on the field consultations, our MDM learning efforts and retreats, and supporting the
interagency issues. (Diana, as you know, is still at DOD but we hope she will be back on the team around
Sept/October.)
Kris -would you be able to share the SOC or any info that comes from the Info Integrity and Resilience IPC
with Stephanie and Croshelle?
Thanks for sharing the Disinformation Index link - would be interesting to learn more. They came in and met with us a
few months ago - would be interesting to connect back with them again.
I'll be on TDY for the next 2 weeks but happy to touch base again later.
Best
Meral
Meral Karan
Team Lead, Democratic Resilience and Innovation Team
Center for Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance
US Agency for International Development

On Fri, Jan 13, 2023 at 10:29 AM Croshelle Harris <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Meral,
Thank you for your time yesterday. It would be nice to have a catch up chat like this on a quarterly
basis, if you're up for it (although I know you may be moving on soon).
I came across this announcement this morning: The Global Disinformation Index. It will be interesting to
see the outcome of these assessments. It's even more interesting to consider the countries they chose
to represent their regions of interest.
Croshelle D. Harris
USAID Deputy Development Advisor
U.S. Special Operations Command (SOCOM)
